snippet.title: Dimhaven The Lost Source - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
From the developers of Quern, Dimhaven: The Lost Source is a narrative driven investigative adventure game set in a fictional 80’s abandoned tourist paradise. It's coming to PC and console early in 2026 - don't forget to Wishlist if you like the look of it! 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #Dimhaven

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
